RITE Energy White Peach lists 0 mg caffeine, one of 16 caffeine-free drinks EnergyDrinkRatings tracks.

It is not stimulant-free, though: the brand's website lists 200 mg paraxanthine per can, a stimulant the body makes when it breaks caffeine down. We list it separately and don't convert it to a caffeine figure.

https://energydrinkratings.com/drinks/rite-energy-white-peach?utm_source=threads&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=edr_rite_paraxanthine

For adults.
